title: 5.2L Accessory Drive — Component Location
introduction:
This component map applies to the 5.2L 32V Ti-VCT accessory drive. I use the large lower crankshaft pulley as a landmark, then trace the cyan belt paths and match their callouts to the adjacent table. That gives the collection of wheels a story: engine rotation is being delivered to the accessories.

Keep the separately identified accessory and A/C compressor belts distinct as you read the perspective view. Also distinguish the idler pulley assembly from the complete accessory drive belt tensioner: the idler guides the belt, while the tensioner’s spring-loaded mechanism maintains tension. A pulley label identifies the belt-contact drive part of the coolant pump, generator or compressor, rather than all the internals of that assembly.

Use this page to locate and name components. Belt removal and installation require the matching service instructions; this drawing supplies no release direction, tool size, tightening value or condition limit.
